entities.summary: Anésia Pinheiro Machado was the second licensed female pilot in Brazil She made her first solo flight on March 17, 1922. In April 1922 she received Brevet No. 77 from the Fédération Aéronautique Internationale (FAI) by Aeroclube do Brasil.

entities.summary: Anésia Pinheiro Machado was the second licensed female pilot in Brazil She made her first solo flight on March 17, 1922. In April 1922 she received Brevet No. 77 from the Fédération Aéronautique Internationale (FAI) by Aeroclube do Brasil.
